profile.headline: Computer Science student as Cal State San Bernardino
profile.summary:
Senior Computer Science student as California State University San Bernardino graduating in Spring 2021 and seeking full time employment opportunities. Currently working as an intern with the California Department of Transportation performing full stack web development. 

Skills: 
- Python
- JavaScript
- HTML/CSS
- C++
- SQL

positions.title: Student Assistant - Software Developer
positions.description: Performed full stack development on web based applications used to monitor field equipment, implementing both back end systems and front end web interfaces. Developed an app for streaming live CCTV video to Android phones.

positions.title: Information Technology Volunteer
positions.description: Created GIS maps using ArcGIS Pro and developed ArcGIS Python scripts.
